verdict.rationale: Cursor is itself an IDE (a VS Code fork), and its docs describe the same agent running inside the Cursor IDE. Skills are invoked with `/` in Agent chat, subagents work in the editor, and the agent helps trace how a repo fits together, which shows in-editor, codebase-aware chat. Missing for 10: a dedicated doc on the in-IDE chat panel, explicit detail on how editor context (open files, selections) feeds the chat, and independent hands-on corroboration of the in-IDE chat experience.
